prior_findings.evidence: Fixed at proposal level: security-contract API-server client authentication specifies both admission plugins, exact service DNS:443 credential lookup, dedicated client CA/EKU/URI allowlist, TLS verification before actionable decoding/allocation, HA startup and rotation; admission-contract applies this before enrollment.

Fixed at proposal level: identity-contract defines ProvenNonStorage using permanent #90 ACTIVE lifetime absence plus repeated complete nodes/reference reads and sticky everStorage, with ordinary drain/refresh recovery and transition-to-storage refusal; admission/spec/design and future fixtures compose these branches.

Fixed at proposal level: identity-contract mandates exact metadata Node.id == Kubernetes name under both grammars and <=128 bytes, immutable enrolled UID, no aliases/address/label inference, and external collision refusal. Existing deploy/csi/driver.yaml --node-id=$(NODE_NAME) and domain.ValidID agree.

Fixed in shared code-review focus: explicit authenticated API-server origin and zero-action handshake rejection replace caBundle-only server authentication; wrong/no client and rotation fixtures cover both plugins.

Fixed in shared code-review focus: existing-name CREATE returns status409/reason AlreadyExists without request-UID allocation; durable exact-name claim serializes absent-name overlap and retains delayed possible commits. Pinned statuserror.go preserves supplied code/reason; real kubelet/API status and contention fixtures are required.

Fixed in shared code-review focus: ProvenNonStorage recovery needs no nonexistent store and retains the single slot on storage appearance, ambiguous history or failed observations. It retains all-Node coverage.

Fixed in shared code-review focus: persisted metadataID/observedStores and immutable slot retirementStores express returned-exact-store and moved-away predicates in actual #90 UUID/generation fields; old/new UID evidence is never rebound, unknown unsaved UUIDs hold, and no-current-UID retirement requires no active refs under the metadata ID.

Fixed in shared code-review focus: four explicit response types use production ForceCodecV2 with nonallocating structural preflight, bounded allocation plan, charged direct construction, no generated response Unmarshal and a shared 64MiB transient/retained pool. Local grpc1.85.0 supports ForceCodecV2 and fragment-backed CodecV2.Unmarshal. Malicious real-gRPC expansion/cancellation fixtures are specified.

Fixed in shared code-review focus: bounded authenticated HTTP1-only listener accounts for pre-handler sockets/TLS/header state and workers, with finite handshake/header/body/request/write/idle waits and actual read cancellation. Pinned local net/http supports the named controls; slow-client/limit+1/recovery fixtures are required.
